title: Yara and the Portrait
author: Yara Nystrom
blurb: Noor Voss, a night-shift dispatcher for a taxi company, has quietly solved three deaths the police called accidents. But when a confession letter arrives postmarked the day after the funeral, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must trap a killer who knows the case file better than the investigators do, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
